verbose.description: Enable verbose logging for detailed diagnostic output.

interface.description: Network interface to capture traffic on (e.g., eth0, wlan0).

tcp_ports.description: TCP ports to monitor. Common choices: 22 (SSH), 80 (HTTP), 443 (HTTPS).

udp_ports.description: UDP ports to monitor. Common choices: 53 (DNS), 123 (NTP).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections LFT will track.

pidfile.description: Path to write the process PID file.

logfile.description: Path to write operational logs. Ensure log directory exists and is writable.

promiscuous.description: Enable promiscuous mode on the interface to capture all traffic (requires root and interface support).

whitelist.description: List of hostnames or IP addresses to *only* monitor. Empty means monitor all (subject to blacklist).

blacklist.description: List of hostnames or IP addresses to ignore. Takes precedence over whitelist.

connection_timeout.description: Idle timeout (in seconds) after which a connection is removed from tracking.

stats_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between logging summary statistics.

payload_capture.description: Enable capture of packet payloads (requires more memory and CPU).

max_payload_size.description: Maximum bytes of payload to capture per connection (only relevant if payload_capture is enabled).

dns_lookup.description: Perform reverse DNS lookups on IP addresses to resolve hostnames in logs/output.
